highlights: Detached bungalow in quiet rural situation
Generous gardens to front, side and rear
summary: Located in a quiet hamlet, close to the Solway Coast & Allonby bay, with excellent access to the facilities & amenities in nearby Aspatria & Wigton, an excellent opportunity to acquire a well-proportioned, 2 bedroom, detached bungalow set in a generous garden plot with pastoral views to the rear.
description:
Offered to the market with no ongoing chain, and found in excellent order throughout having been recently renovated and improved by our clients, Sunset View is a most appealing and always sought after style of detached bungalow, located in this ever popular rural area to the west of the county, easily accessible to Carlisle, the Solway Coast and the Northern Fells section of the Lake District National Park.

Occupying a generous plot, with ample off road parking and low maintenance gardens with extension or development potential, subject to the necessary permissions, the accommodation comprises the entrance hallway, living / dining room, kitchen, 2 bedrooms and bathroom.

Driveway parking leads to the attached garage.

Sat in a slightly elevated position, the property enjoys expansive views over fields to the rear and as such should be viewed to fully appreciate.

Directions From Carlisle head towards Wigton taking the A596. Head towards through Waverton and take the right hand turning after 2.5 miles. The house is on the right hand side after the farm.
